def transform(grid):
    """Fill interiors of monochrome rectangular outline objects."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            color = grid[sr][sc]
            if color == background or (sr, sc) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(sr, sc)]
            seen.add((sr, sc))
            pts = []
            while stack:
                r, c = stack.pop()
                pts.append((r, c))
                for rr, cc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color and (rr,cc) not in seen:
                        seen.add((rr,cc))
                        stack.append((rr,cc))
            r0 = min(r for r,c in pts); r1 = max(r for r,c in pts)
            c0 = min(c for r,c in pts); c1 = max(c for r,c in pts)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            if (all(grid[r0][c] == color and grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1))):
                fill = 2 if color == 6 else 7
                for r in range(r0+1, r1):
                    for c in range(c0+1, c1):
                        out[r][c] = fill
    return out
PY
